transcript_tail.text:
This is the **full Experience history** — real titles, dates, and quantified accomplishments. Exactly what was gated. Now I can write the real resume. Key facts:

- **Visa** (11 yrs): **Engineering Manager** (Jan 2019–present) + **Lead Software Engineer** (Apr 2015–Dec 2018) — the Lead role is your tech-lead anchor (led 5 engineers, +3% cashless in Japan).
- **TrialPay** — Mobile Engineer (2013–15; built 3rd-gen SDK iOS/Android/Unity3D; acquired by Visa).
- **MoWaiter** — Co-founder & CTO (2011–13; built iOS app + PHP/Symfony2 back end + AWS from scratch).
- **Nangate** — EDA tools (2006–11; C++/Perl; cut config time 4 days→6 hrs).
- **Fujitsu Labs of America** — Research Staff (2005–06; clock-network CAD, C++).
- **UFRGS:** M.S. + B.S. in **Computer Engineering**.

Let me write the complete Experience, Skills, and Education sections, reframed builder-first (technical outcomes lead; EM people-management bullets dropped).
Now the LinkedIn experience entries with the real, reframed content.
The export also revealed your **"Open to Work — recruiters only"** toggle is *already on* (Milpitas +3, on-site/hybrid/remote). Let me note that.
Now let me update the README — the experience dump closed nearly all the gaps. Let me read the current README to revise the status accurately.
Let me update the memory now that the full career history is known (it was recorded as "gated").

Done — the drafts are now **complete with your real career data**, reframed builder-first. Everything that was gated is filled in.

## What changed this round

**`resume/resume.md`** — full Experience section written from your profile dump:
- **Visa — Engineering Manager** (Jan 2019–present): kept the technical/scale bullets (big-data 50×, downtime −60%, Spring Boot/Angular migration, test coverage 30→80%); **dropped the people-management bullets** (scrum communication, "offered feedback") per the IC pivot.
- **Visa — Lead Software Engineer** (Apr 2015–Dec 2018): surfaced as your strongest tech-lead proof (led 5, +3% cashless in Japan, 1.5M annotations/wk).
- **TrialPay**, **MoWaiter** (Co-founder/CTO), **Nangate** (EDA), **Fujitsu Labs** — all with real bullets.
- Skills rewritten with your actual stack (C++, Perl, Objective-C, Spring Boot, Hive, AWS, …); Education = M.S.+B.S. Computer Engineering, UFRGS.

**`resume/linkedin.md`** — reframed experience bullets to paste in, plus the note that *Open to Work (recruiters only)* is already on.

**Privacy:** kept birth year (1978), home ZIP, and street address **off** the resume — they were in the dumps.

Memory updated with the full career history, so future sessions have it.
